program:
param richTxtDEU,richTxtENU :string, byref TitleENU, TitleDEU, DescriptionENU, DescriptionDEU:string
var commentObj:object := ~.Comment

commentObj.saveAsRichedit := true
commentObj.cont := richTxtDEU
commentObj.saveAsRichedit := false
var str:string := commentObj.cont
var cutPos:integer := strLpos(chr(10),str)
TitleDEU  := removeUnwantedCharacter(strCopy(str,1,cutPos))
DescriptionDEU := removeUnwantedCharacter(strTrim(strCopy(str,cutPos,strLen(str))))

commentObj.saveAsRichedit := true
commentObj.cont := richTxtENU
commentObj.saveAsRichedit := false
str := commentObj.cont -- Poor text (not rich text) is needed for searching.
cutPos := strLpos(chr(10),str)
TitleENU  := removeUnwantedCharacter(strCopy(str,1,cutPos))
DescriptionENU := removeUnwantedCharacter(strTrim(strCopy(str,cutPos,strLen(str))))
